task.name: Retire legacy StoreProvider and static catalog production authority

head_policy.description: For an active branch task, the live task/PR head may differ from task_head only by descendant commits whose complete diff from task_head is restricted to the canonical execution-state file and explicitly referenced state-history snapshots. Completed merged tasks retain their accepted code task_head plus explicit merge evidence.

history_snapshots.coverage: All canonical execution state, failed-gate history and acceptance evidence recorded before P1-C closure / P1-D activation.

acceptance_criteria: Inventory every remaining production import or consumer of resources/js/platform/store.jsx, StoreProvider, useStore, resources/js/data/catalog.js and apiBackend before deleting or unmounting anything.
Remove the global StoreProvider wrapper from resources/js/main.jsx only after repository evidence proves no live production consumer still depends on its context.

Retire resources/js/platform/store.jsx as production business authority; if any development/test fixture behavior must remain, isolate it behind an explicitly named DEV/TEST-only boundary that cannot activate in production.
Retire resources/js/data/catalog.js from production runtime authority; delete it when unused or move retained demo data to an explicit development/test fixture boundary with no live-route imports.

No authoritative balances, inventory, orders, returns, coupons, shipping prices, games, gifts, messages, finance state, eligibility or other business truth may remain in localStorage or static fixtures.
Production API failures must fail closed or show retry/error states and must never reactivate legacy StoreProvider/static catalog business state.
Extend frontend/source regression gates so live production code cannot reintroduce StoreProvider/useStore, apiBackend dual routing or static catalog business imports after retirement.
Preserve customer storefront, account, Seller Center and Admin route URLs and visual behavior; P1-D is authority retirement, not a redesign or unrelated refactor.

Run focused source/runtime/browser evidence plus production build and exact-head Governance Code Scanning, CodeQL and full CI including SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL, browser E2E/WCAG/W3C and runtime integration/restore/launch gate before merge.
P1 package may be marked 4/4 complete only after P1-D exact-head acceptance, protected merge and canonical closure evidence.
